description.en: Pick up a lantern. Explore a dungeon powered by Python, with turn-based combat and saves behind a Canvas interface.

kind.zh-CN: 音乐可视化 / 钢琴练习

description.zh-CN: 从 MusicXML 出发，听见音乐，也看见每一次触键。下落音符与五线谱共同跟随真实钢琴声音，支持慢练与片段循环。
description.en: From MusicXML to sound. See every keystroke in falling notes or sheet music, with SoundFont piano playback, slower practice, and loops.

kind.zh-CN: 双端编辑 / 桥接实验室

description.zh-CN: 修改 Python 与 JavaScript，让桥接过程清晰可见。六个可编辑案例展示函数、异步 Promise、实时对象和容器、异常及快照。
description.en: Edit both sides. See Python and JavaScript work together through six editable examples covering functions, promises, live proxies, errors, and snapshots.

kind.zh-CN: ARPG 装备 / 网格背包

description.zh-CN: 整理遗物、穿戴装备、拆分堆叠并镶嵌宝石。Python 后端持有权威状态与规则，Vue 界面在收到后端事件后刷新展示副本。
description.en: Arrange relics, equip gear, split stacks, and socket gems. Python owns the inventory state and rules; the Vue interface refreshes detached render snapshots after backend events.
